minimum: Run check_orchestrator_root.py from the active Repo Annotation installation with --repo-root set to the monorepo root.

validation_entrypoints.name: sdd-orchestrator-root
validation_entrypoints.command: Run check_orchestrator_root.py from the active Repo Annotation installation with --repo-root set to the monorepo root.
validation_entrypoints.scope: Root routing manifest, root overrides, package routes, and routing blocks

surface_owners.edit_boundary: Repo Annotation refreshes only the marker-delimited package routing blocks and the onboarded workspace_packages entries; all other root content is human-owned.

fallback_rules: Read the routed package's AGENTS.md and .sdd/manifest.json before changing package code.
When a package is not listed in .sdd/manifest.json packages, treat its code as the only source of truth.
